key_reasoning.reason: Diff touches 4 distinct components: two API routers (project_settings.py, user_settings.py) with symmetric elif branches, a new service-layer validator (validate_ms_teams_request in settings_request_validator.py), a new model-layer classmethod (Settings.check_ms_teams_singleton), and the shared CredentialTypes enum in codemie_tools/base/models.py used by ~30 other integration types — bumped from M to L for touching that core shared enum.

The implementation reads as a clean single pass: assistant_ids validation, singleton-per-project enforcement, and PROJECT-only scope restriction are each expressed as one coherent block reusing existing helpers (AssistantService.belongs_to_project, get_by_fields) with no leftover TODOs or inconsistent branches — no rework or ambiguity signals visible in the diff.
